verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מֶֽה־ הָ֣יָה לָ֔נוּ הַבֵּיט וּרְאֵ֥ה אֶת־ חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr Yah·weh meh- hā·yāh lā·nū hab·bēṭ ū·rə·’êh ’eṯ- ḥer·pā·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: Remember O LORD what has happened to us Look and see our disgrace
verses.literalPt: LEMBRA-TE, SENHOR, do que nos tem sucedido; considera, e olha o nosso opróbrio.

verses.original: נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ נֶֽהֶפְכָ֣ה לְזָרִ֔ים בָּתֵּ֖ינוּ לְנָכְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ne·hep̄·ḵāh lə·zā·rîm bāt·tê·nū lə·nā·ḵə·rîm
verses.literal: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers our houses to foreigners
verses.literalPt: A nossa herança passou a estrangeiros, e as nossas casas a forasteiros.

verses.original: יְתוֹמִ֤ים הָיִ֙ינוּ֙ אֵין אָ֔ב אִמֹּתֵ֖ינוּ כְּאַלְמָנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ṯō·w·mîm hā·yî·nū ʾēn ’āḇ ’im·mō·ṯê·nū kə·’al·mā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: We have become fatherless . . . orphans our mothers are widows
verses.literalPt: Órfãos somos sem pai, nossas mães são como viúvas.

verses.original: מֵימֵ֙ינוּ֙ בְּכֶ֣סֶף שָׁתִ֔ינוּ עֵצֵ֖ינוּ בִּמְחִ֥יר יָבֹֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·mê·nū bə·ḵe·sep̄ šā·ṯî·nū ‘ê·ṣê·nū bim·ḥîr yā·ḇō·’ū
verses.literal: We must buy the water we drink our wood comes at a price
verses.literalPt: A nossa água por dinheiro a bebemos, por preço vem a nossa lenha.

verses.original: עַ֤ל צַוָּארֵ֙נוּ֙ נִרְדָּ֔פְנוּ יָגַ֖עְנוּ לֹא הֽוּנַ֖ח לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ṣaw·wā·rê·nū nir·dā·p̄ə·nū yā·ḡa‘·nū lō hū·naḥ lā·nū
verses.literal: We are closely . . . pursued we are weary and find no rest
verses.literalPt: Os nossos perseguidores estão sobre os nossos pescoços; estamos cansados, e não temos descanso.

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ נָתַ֣נּוּ יָ֔ד אַשּׁ֖וּר לִשְׂבֹּ֥עַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·ra·yim nā·ṯan·nū yāḏ ’aš·šūr liś·bō·a‘ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: We submitted . . . to Egypt and Assyria to get enough bread
verses.literalPt: Aos egípcios e aos assírios estendemos as mãos, para nos fartarem de pão.

verses.original: אֲבֹתֵ֤ינוּ חָֽטְאוּ֙ אֵינָם אֲנַחְנוּ עֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶ֥ם סָבָֽלְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū ḥā·ṭə·’ū ʾē·nå̄m ʾă·naḥ·nū ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·hem sā·ḇā·lə·nū
verses.literal: Our fathers sinned and are no more but we bear their punishment
verses.literalPt: Nossos pais pecaram, e já não existem; e nós levamos as suas maldades.

verses.original: עֲבָדִים֙ מָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֔נוּ פֹּרֵ֖ק אֵ֥ין מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm mā·šə·lū ḇā·nū pō·rêq ’ên mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: Slaves rule over us there is no one to deliver us from their hands
verses.literalPt: Servos dominam sobre nós; ninguém há que nos livre da sua mão.

verses.original: בְּנַפְשֵׁ֙נוּ֙ נָבִ֣יא לַחְמֵ֔נוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nap̄·šê·nū nā·ḇî laḥ·mê·nū mip·pə·nê ḥe·reḇ ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Com perigo de nossas vidas trazemos o nosso pão, por causa da espada do deserto.

verses.original: עוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ כְּתַנּ֣וּר נִכְמָ֔רוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י זַלְעֲפ֥וֹת רָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·rê·nū kə·ṯan·nūr niḵ·mā·rū mip·pə·nê zal·‘ă·p̄ō·wṯ rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from our hunger
verses.literalPt: Nossa pele se queimou como um forno, por causa do ardor da fome.

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ בְּצִיּ֣וֹן עִנּ֔וּ בְּתֻלֹ֖ת בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nā·šîm bə·ṣî·yō·wn ‘in·nū bə·ṯu·lōṯ bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Women have been ravished in Zion virgins in the cities of Judah
verses.literalPt: Forçaram as mulheres em Sião, as virgens nas cidades de Judá.

verses.original: שָׂרִים֙ בְּיָדָ֣ם נִתְל֔וּ פְּנֵ֥י זְקֵנִ֖ים לֹ֥א נֶהְדָּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rîm bə·yā·ḏām niṯ·lū pə·nê zə·qê·nîm lō neh·dā·rū
verses.literal: Princes have been hung up by their hands elders receive no respect . . .
verses.literalPt: Os príncipes foram enforcados pelas mãos deles; as faces dos velhos não foram reverenciadas.

verses.original: בַּחוּרִים֙ טְח֣וֹן נָשָׂ֔אוּ וּנְעָרִ֖ים בָּעֵ֥ץ כָּשָֽׁלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥū·rîm ṭə·ḥō·wn nā·śā·’ū ū·nə·‘ā·rîm bā·‘êṣ kā·šā·lū
verses.literal: Young men toil at millstones boys stagger under loads of wood
verses.literalPt: Aos jovens obrigaram a moer, e os meninos caíram debaixo das cargas de lenha.

verses.original: זְקֵנִים֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר שָׁבָ֔תוּ בַּחוּרִ֖ים מִנְּגִינָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zə·qê·nîm miš·ša·‘ar šā·ḇā·ṯū ba·ḥū·rîm min·nə·ḡî·nā·ṯām
verses.literal: The elders have left the city gate the young men have stopped their music
verses.literalPt: Os velhos já não estão mais às portas, os jovens já deixaram a sua música.

verses.original: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ לִבֵּ֔נוּ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְאֵ֖בֶל מְחֹלֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ḇaṯ mə·śō·wś lib·bê·nū neh·paḵ lə·’ê·ḇel mə·ḥō·lê·nū
verses.literal: Joy has left our hearts our dancing has turned to mourning
verses.literalPt: Cessou o gozo de nosso coração; converteu-se em lamentação a nossa dança.

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אֽוֹי־ נָ֥א לָ֖נוּ כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: nā·p̄ə·lāh ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ rō·šê·nū ’ō·w- nā lā·nū kî ḥā·ṭā·nū
verses.literal: The crown has fallen from our head Woe . . . to us for we have sinned
verses.literalPt: Caiu a coroa da nossa cabeça; ai de nós! porque pecamos.

verses.original: עַל־ זֶ֗ה הָיָ֤ה דָוֶה֙ לִבֵּ֔נוּ עַל־ אֵ֖לֶּה חָשְׁכ֥וּ עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zeh hā·yāh ḏā·weh lib·bê·nū ‘al- ’êl·leh ḥā·šə·ḵū ‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: Because of this our hearts are faint because of these our eyes grow dim
verses.literalPt: Por isso desmaiou o nosso coração; por isso se escureceram os nossos olhos.

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר־ צִיּוֹן֙ שֶׁשָּׁמֵ֔ם שׁוּעָלִ֖ים הִלְּכוּ־ בֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘al har- ṣî·yō·wn šeš·šā·mêm šū·‘ā·lîm hil·lə·ḵū- ḇōw
verses.literal: because of Mount Zion which lies desolate patrolled by foxes
verses.literalPt: Pelo monte de Sião, que está assolado, andam as raposas.

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֔ב כִּסְאֲךָ֖ לְדֹ֥ר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām tê·šêḇ kis·’ă·ḵā lə·ḏōr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: You O LORD reign forever Your throne endures from generation to generation
verses.literalPt: Tu, SENHOR, permaneces eternamente, e o teu trono subsiste de geração em geração.

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה לָנֶ֙צַח֙ תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֔נוּ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֖נוּ לְאֹ֥רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh lā·ne·ṣaḥ tiš·kā·ḥê·nū ta·‘az·ḇê·nū lə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Why have You forgotten us forever Why have You forsaken us for so long . . .
verses.literalPt: Por que te esquecerias de nós para sempre? Por que nos desampararias por tanto tempo?

verses.original: הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וְנָשׁוּב חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·šî·ḇê·nū Yah·weh ’ê·le·ḵā wə·nå̄·šūḇ ḥad·dêš yā·mê·nū kə·qe·ḏem
verses.literal: Restore us to Yourself O LORD so we may return renew our days as of old
verses.literalPt: Converte-nos a ti, SENHOR, e seremos convertidos; renova os nossos dias como dantes.

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־ מָאֹ֣ס מְאַסְתָּ֔נוּ קָצַ֥פְתָּ עָלֵ֖ינוּ עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- mā·’ōs mə·’as·tā·nū qā·ṣap̄·tā ‘ā·lê·nū ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: unless . . . You have utterly rejected us . . . and remain angry with us beyond measure . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas tu nos rejeitaste totalmente. Tu estás muito enfurecido contra nós.
